record.paper_title: Open problems in dynamics and related fields
record.original_question: Let G be a Lie group, Γ a lattice in G, U={u(t)} a one-parameter Ad-unipotent subgroup, and x∈G/Γ with dense Ux. Can one prove equidistribution in G/Γ of {u(t_n)x} when t_n is [n^α] for α>1, [P(n)] for a polynomial P, or the nth prime number?

evidence.quote: QUESTION 16 (G. Margulis [174]). Prove equidistribution of the sequence{u(tn)x} in G/Γ, where t n is one of the following: 1. tn = [nα]3 for α > 1, 2. tn = [P (n)], where P (x) is a polynomial, 3. tn is the n-th prime number .

artifact.self_contained_problem:
Let $G$ be a connected Lie group, $\Gamma \subset G$ a lattice, and $U = \{u(t) : t \in \mathbb{R}\}$ a one-parameter Ad-unipotent subgroup of $G$ (i.e., $\mathrm{Ad}(u(t))$ is a unipotent linear operator on the Lie algebra of $G$ for every $t$). By Ratner's theorem, for every $x \in G/\Gamma$ such that the orbit $Ux$ is dense in $G/\Gamma$, the continuous orbit $\{u(t)x : t \in [0,T]\}$ becomes equidistributed in $G/\Gamma$ (with respect to the $G$-invariant probability measure) as $T \to \infty$.

Prove (or disprove) that for every such $G$, $\Gamma$, $U$, and every $x \in G/\Gamma$ with $\overline{Ux} = G/\Gamma$, the discrete sparse orbit $\{u(t_n) x : n \in \mathbb{N}\}$ is equidistributed in $G/\Gamma$ when $t_n$ is any of the following sequences:
1. $t_n = \lfloor n^\alpha \rfloor$ for a fixed real $\alpha > 1$;
2. $t_n = \lfloor P(n) \rfloor$ for a fixed non-constant polynomial $P(x) \in \mathbb{R}[x]$;
3. $t_n = p_n$, the $n$-th prime number.

Here equidistribution means that for every $f \in C_c(G/\Gamma)$,
$$\frac{1}{N}\sum_{n=1}^{N} f(u(t_n)x) \;\longrightarrow\; \int_{G/\Gamma} f\, d\mu \quad \text{as } N \to \infty,$$
where $\mu$ is the $G$-invariant probability measure on $G/\Gamma$.
artifact.status_search_result: The problem (a question of Margulis) is known in several special cases but remains open in full generality. Partial results include: equidistribution along $\lfloor n^{1+\gamma}\rfloor$ for small $\gamma > 0$ and along primes in horocycle flows on $\mathrm{PSL}(2,\mathbb{R})/\Gamma$ (Venkatesh; Sarnak–Ubis; Tanis–Vishe), and recent polynomial effective equidistribution results (Lindenstrauss–Mohammadi–Wang and others) that give some sparse equidistribution applications. Equidistribution for general one-parameter Ad-unipotent flows on arbitrary $G/\Gamma$ along $\lfloor n^\alpha\rfloor$ for all $\alpha > 1$, along arbitrary polynomial sequences, or along the primes is not established in general.

status_evidence.title: Sparse equidistribution problems, period bounds and subconvexity (Venkatesh)
status_evidence.snippet: Equidistribution along sequences n^{1+gamma} (small gamma) for horocycle orbits in PSL(2,R)/Gamma.
status_evidence.claim: Partial progress on Margulis' sparse equidistribution question in the rank-one horocycle setting.

status_evidence.title: Polynomial effective equidistribution (Lindenstrauss–Mohammadi–Wang)
status_evidence.snippet: Effective equidistribution for one-parameter unipotent flows in SL_2(R)-arithmetic quotients with applications to sparse equidistribution.
status_evidence.claim: Recent advances give effective/sparse results in specific homogeneous settings but not full generality.

status_evidence.title: Weak mixing and sparse equidistribution
status_evidence.snippet: Studies sparse equidistribution problems related to Margulis' question.
status_evidence.claim: Active recent work shows the general problem remains under investigation.
